name: ML PoS Prior
description: PubMedBERT-embedded eligibility-criteria text + 36-dim structured features → LightGBM classifier supervised on real HINT clinical-trial outcomes (Fu et al. 2022). 804-dim combined feature space; test AUC 0.7030 on the HINT held-out test split. v0.2.0 replaces v0.1.x's rule-distilled logistic surrogate with the supervised model. The runtime engine embeds eligibility-criteria text in-container (PubMedBERT-base, ~440MB); novel asset inputs supply text via the criteria_text field or fetch via nct_id from ClinicalTrials.gov v2.
